definition.name: Metamagic Options
definition.description: Native Band 1 Sorcerer feature; shared engine constraints and approved owner reconciliation apply.

options.name: Careful Spell
options.effect: chosen creatures auto-succeed and avoid half-damage on saves

options.name: Distant Spell
options.effect: double applicable spell range or extend Touch range to 30 feet

options.name: Empowered Spell
options.effect: reroll Cha-modifier damage dice, using new rolls; combines with another

options.name: Extended Spell
options.effect: double duration up to 24 hours and grant Advantage on Concentration saves

options.name: Heightened Spell
options.effect: one target Disadvantage on all saves against spell

options.name: Quickened Spell
options.effect: Action spell becomes Bonus Action; same-turn leveled spell restriction

options.name: Seeking Spell
options.effect: reroll a missed spell attack; combines with another

options.name: Subtle Spell
options.effect: remove verbal, somatic and unpriced nonconsumed material components

options.name: Transmuted Spell
options.effect: convert acid cold fire lightning poison thunder damage

options.name: Twinned Spell
options.effect: select exactly one of Twin and Expanded Targeting
